# Paper.design MCP Integration Proposal

## Context

We currently have a gap between "user describes UI" and "Claude generates code." Excalidraw handles rough architecture diagrams. shadcn/kibo-ui provides production components. The frontend-design skill generates code with taste enforcement. But there's no visual design tool in the loop — no way to see, iterate on, and refine a UI visually before or alongside code generation.
